admission_requirements.general_requirements: Jordanian General Secondary Certificate (Tawjihi) or equivalent; minimum scores vary by major: 60% for most humanities, IT, and business programs; 65% for Law; 70% for Clinical Nutrition; 80% for Pharmacy, Civil Engineering, and Architecture.
admission_requirements.exam_details: Placement tests in Arabic, English, and IT for new students to determine language and computer proficiency levels; technical abilities aptitude test required for Architecture and Design programs.
admission_requirements.english_requirement: No specific English proficiency score required for undergraduate admission; English exam (IELTS/TOEFL) required for master's program admission with minimum scores varying by program (IELTS 5.0-6.5 or TOEFL IBT 59-90).

tuition_fees.credit_hour_fees: 30-120 JOD per credit hour depending on program
tuition_fees.notes: Additional fees: registration 200 JOD, service fees 170 JOD per regular semester; insurance 100 JOD (refundable); application fees 40 JOD; placement test 45 JOD (undergraduate). Summer semester: registration 100 JOD, service fees 85 JOD. Fees listed are for the academic year 2022/2023.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHE); ABET (Engineering & IT programs); [uncertain] ACPE (Pharmacy); ISO 9001 [uncertain]

market_demand.notes: University operates Career Guidance and Alumni Office. Exact employment rate not publicly available on the website.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: Student dormitory available; transportation services provided to all areas in Amman, Zarqa, and Madaba for a nominal fee.
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Incentive discount up to 20% on master's programs; additional scholarship details available through Deanship of Student Affairs.

contact_info.address: Airport Road, Amman, Jordan P.O Box 961343
